verdict.rationale: Signifyd provides a device-fingerprinting script (docs-10/20) and Checkout/Sale APIs that submit order and payment details for fraud review (docs-3,18,21,22), which lets developers feed some proprietary signals into scoring. However there's no documented support for arbitrary custom metadata fields or explicit behavioral-data ingestion beyond the fixed device-profiling script and order schema. Missing for 10: explicit custom metadata/field schema, behavioral-data signal ingestion, and evidence that submitted signals demonstrably alter the scoring model beyond the default order fields.
